title: 第3章 做夫妻该做的事第4章 跟他分手了
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第3章做夫妻，该做的事唐凝怔住了，心跳加速。
在纪瑾修低头要吻住她的时候，她身体不由地抖了一下。
察觉到她的反应，纪瑾修的动作停住了，幽深的眸子一片克制之色。
“怎么，害怕？”
唐凝还没回过神。
纪瑾修食指刮了下唐凝的鼻翼，好笑道：“逗你玩而已，别当真。”
随后，唐凝感觉身上的重量一轻。
纪瑾修已经从她身上起来，走向浴室，去洗澡了。
看着他的背影，唐凝终于松口气，轻轻拍了拍胸口，脸却还烫得厉害。
刚才她还以为要那什么了……
其实她倒不是多保守的人，可他到底是纪寒的亲哥。
纪瑾修以前对她就特别严肃，明明不比自己大几岁，却跟个年轻的老头似的。
这感觉，太别扭了。
尤其三年前，她和纪瑾修还发生过那种尴尬的事……
算了算了。
唐凝甩甩头，没再继续想。
等纪瑾修洗完澡出来，唐凝已经接受跟他住在一起的事实了，也去洗了个澡。
洗澡加护肤、擦身体乳，足足花了一个半小时。
她都以为纪瑾修应该睡了。
没想到浴室门一推开，纪瑾修戏谑的声音便响起：“我以为你要住里面。”

这嘴巴，一如既往的淬了毒。
唐凝已经习惯了，走到床尾的地方站着，试探性问：“我，睡哪？”
纪瑾修俊美的脸上挑了眉，“唐凝，我们的结婚证应该是合法合规的情况下领的？”
“对呀。”唐凝一时半会没反应过来。
“所以，你见过哪对合法，新婚夫妻分房睡的？”
纪瑾修成功把唐凝问住了。
算了。
唐凝放弃狡辩。
“过来。”
纪瑾修拍了拍身边的位置。
这次，唐凝很配合的走过去。
刚躺下，耳边又传来纪瑾修玩味的声音，“纪夫人，床给你暖好了。”
唐凝扭头，看他的眼神都变得十分诡异，到底是忍无可忍了。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Things to do as a couple. Tang Ning was stunned and her heart beat faster.
When Ji Jinxiu lowered his head to kiss her, her body trembled involuntarily.
After noticing her reaction, Ji Jinxiu stopped moving, his deep eyes showing restraint.
"What, scared?"
Tang Ning hasn't recovered yet.
Ji Jinxiu scratched Tang Ning's nose with his index finger and said with a smile: "I'm just teasing you, don't take it seriously."
Then, Tang Ning felt the weight on her body lighten.
Ji Jinxiu had already gotten up from her body and walked to the bathroom to take a shower.
Looking at his back, Tang Ning finally breathed a sigh of relief and patted his chest gently, but his face was still very hot.
Just now she thought she wanted something like that...
In fact, she is not a very conservative person, but he is Ji Han's brother after all.
Ji Jinxiu used to be very serious with her. He was obviously not a few years older than him, but he acted like a young old man.
This feeling is so awkward.
Especially three years ago, something embarrassing happened between her and Ji Jinxiu...
Forget it.
Tang Ning shook her head and stopped thinking.
By the time Ji Jinxiu came out of the shower, Tang Ning had accepted the fact of living with him and went to take a shower.
It took a full hour and a half to take a shower, apply skin care, and apply body lotion.
She thought Ji Jinxiu should be sleeping.
Unexpectedly, as soon as the bathroom door opened, Ji Jinxiu's joking voice sounded: "I thought you wanted to live in there."
This mouth is as poisonous as ever.
Tang Ning was used to it. She walked to the end of the bed and stood there, tentatively asking, "Where will I sleep?"
Ji Jinxiu raised an eyebrow on his handsome face, "Tang Ning, should our marriage certificate be obtained legally and compliantly?"
"Yes." Tang Ning didn't react for a while.
"So, have you ever seen any legally newlyweds sleeping in separate rooms?"
Ji Jinxiu successfully asked Tang Ning.
never mind.
Tang Ning gave up her excuses.
"Come here."
Ji Jinxiu patted the place next to him.
This time, Tang Ning walked over very cooperatively.
Just as he lay down, Ji Jinxiu's playful voice came to his ears again, "Mrs. Ji, the bed has been warmed for you."
Tang Ning turned her head and looked at him with a very strange look. She couldn't bear it anymore.
